seo.flights.can: Compares 6 active flight sources. Prices per person, cheapest first. Final price incl. baggage only when the source states it.
seo.flights.cannot: No guarantee of final price, seat or availability. No booking, no payment. Taxes only when the source itemises them.
seo.hotels.can: Compares hotel prices per night and room from 6 sources, including a star filter.
seo.hotels.cannot: No room count, no cancellation terms, no availability guarantee. Taxes are often not itemised. No booking.
seo.faehren.can: Compares ferry prices from 2 sources (Ferryhopper, Finnlines), per person for a one-way trip.
seo.faehren.cannot: No vehicle fares, not all sources provide booking links, no cancellation information. Finnlines expects port codes.
seo.kreuzfahrten.can: Compares cruise prices from 2 sources (Holland America, Royal Caribbean), per person for the whole trip.
seo.kreuzfahrten.cannot: No cabin availability, no drinks/all-inclusive guarantee, no booking. Sorted by base price – taxes may be missing.
